description: Experience the power of application-specific AI. Akkio makes it easy for media agencies to easily and instantly understand their data across campaign workflows and act on it for better, faster client results. No-Code AI Modeling: Build predictive models without coding, ideal for marketing and sales analytics. Chat Explore™: Interact with data using natural language queries. Data Preparation Tools: Clean and transform data efficiently. Generative Reports: Automatically generate insights and reports from data.
